description: Checks a Shopify store’s Black Friday readiness in four scored parts: gift searches its products fit (real monthly Google searches and the store’s position today, in its main market or the one `country` names), who is #1 for the store’s own "<brand> black friday" search and whether its sale states dates, how to get the discount and what’s included, its return, shipping and delivery details, and whether its public Shopify AI answers those questions correctly. Every problem comes with evidence and a fix brief. Free, no sign-in; waits up to 45 seconds, then returns progress and report links. Anything it could not check is reported as unchecked with its reason, never scored.

country.description: The market to check, as a two-letter ISO country code such as GB. Omit it for the store’s main market.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.
